$comment: HZ-972: the contract for a project's quant resource registry, farm/projects/<slug>/quant_resources.json — the only list of sources a quant persona may cite. Metadata only: no third-party code or paper is ever committed to Horizon; code and papers live in the private store repo named by `store`, checked out on the box at store.path. Validated by domain/validate.mjs's Draft-07 subset, so there is no `pattern`. Rules the subset cannot express — store.sha and pinned.sha are 40 lowercase hex, sha256 is 64 lowercase hex, ids are unique and match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$, library.repo and library.path follow the knowledge-source shape of domain/projectPersonas.schema.json — are asserted at LOAD time by validateQuantResources() in server/src/quantResources.js. A golden case cites an entry through its knowledge-library slug, knowledgeSlug(library.repo, library.path) in server/src/knowledgeDocs.js, which is derived and never stored.
title: Horizon quant resource registry: every source a quant persona may cite

store.$comment: The private repo holding the pinned libraries (git submodules) and the papers, and the commit infra/host/install-quant-resources.sh checks out at `path`. Bumping `sha` is a reviewed registry change.

readers.$comment: The persona ids whose runs may read the store and this registry (farm/quant_resources.py): read-only add_dirs for a step agent. Any other persona's run is unchanged.

kind.$comment: library: a pinned source checkout in the store; venv and python_package: the store's Python venv and a package pinned in it; repo_file: a file in a FinTekkers repo; standard: a rule or standard; data: an official data source; paper: a paper in the store's papers/; knowledge_doc: a Horizon-written knowledge document.

location.$comment: A path in the store, a repo path or a URL.

pinned.$comment: The release tag (or pip spec) and, for a checkout, its commit.

use.$comment: read_and_copy: permissive, follow the licence. read_and_run_only: GPL, AGPL, non-commercial, unlicensed or publisher material — read and run to derive or check values, never copy into a FinTekkers repo.

library.$comment: The knowledge-library source this entry is indexed as: a PDF in a repo.
